title: A session signature for one wallet also validates for another: the same test with its assertion turned around

source.adaptedHow: A test of our own, written from the finding's description, that asserts the safe property, so it fails while the bug is present. The finding's test drains two wallets it set up with vm.store; this one asks the session manager directly, with no storage write.

program.name: Code4rena
program.verdict: Valid. Listed under Medium Risk Findings as M-01 in the published report; no judge or sponsor comment on the page.

expected.reason: The same test with the assertion turned around passes on all three runs, so its case fails on what it says it does, and reproduces fails on its own here.
